Non-view functions (ABI via snowtrace getabi on the impls) are only ERC4626 user actions (deposit/mint/redeem/withdraw/depositAVAX/redeemAVAX), owner setters (setAVAXCap/setTargetAPR/setGGPCap), role/upgrade admin, and four keeper-like ones: AVAX updateRewards(), GGP distributeRewards() / stakeAndDistributeRewards(address) / stakeOnNode(uint256,address), depositFromStaking(uint256). eth_call of every one of them from a fresh address (0x5AbCEf00...A1) reverts: AVAX updateRewards -> 'Unauthorized rewards updater account' (onlyRewardsUpdater: owner OR REWARDS_SYNCER OR APPROVED_NODE_OPERATOR); the other four -> 'Caller is not the owner or an approved node operator'. Nothing is permissionless, and none of them transfers anything to the caller anyway: _updateRewards/_distributeRewards only add virtual yield to stakingTotalAssets (share-price accrual), no payment to msg.sender. The only caller today is keeper EOA 0x804c8fc862c342c077fb04614e1c5e8e2c85b6b5, which holds REWARDS_SYNCER (hasRole=true, APPROVED_NODE_OPERATOR=false) and calls AVAX updateRewards() every ~33 min (303 txs in 7 days by keeper nonce delta 32572-32269 between block 100041673 and latest 100683116; sample of 100 of ~303: all updateRewards(), 53,691 gas each = 0.000403 AVAX = 0.0028 USD @ 7.5 gwei and AVAX 6.985). Caveat for later scouts: the keyless snowtrace txlist index lags about 7 days (newest indexed tx 6.7 d old while lastRewardUpdate() was 23 min old), so explorer-only 'no recent txs' here is an artifact - use state reads or the nonce delta.
